connector.name: Chronary
connector.registryDescription: Calendar API for AI agents: events, availability, Google/Microsoft setup, scheduling, and iCal.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.chronary.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.chronary, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer auth with your Chronary API key, e.g. 'Bearer chr_sk_...'.

env.name: CHRONARY_API_KEY
env.description: Chronary API key - org key (chr_sk_...) or agent-scoped key (chr_ak_...). Request access at https://chronary.ai.
